source.text: 7.2 Where the Buyer places a single Purchase Order for 100 or more Units, the Vendor shall allow the Buyer a volume discount of twelve per cent (12%) on the Order Value of that Purchase Order, and the discount shall be shown as a separate deduction on the Invoice.
The Buyer shall pay each Invoice that is correct and undisputed within a period of sixty (60) days reckoned from the date of the Invoice.

7.1 The price payable by the Buyer for each Unit of the Lenovo ThinkPad T14 Laptop shall be PKR 275,000 (the "Agreed Unit Price"). No Invoice issued by the Vendor shall charge any sum in excess of the Agreed Unit Price per Unit, and any amount invoiced above that figure shall not be payable by the Buyer.

issues.quote: 5.3 Where the Vendor delivers the Equipment under the Initial Order after the Delivery Deadline, the Vendor shall pay to the Buyer, as a genuine pre-estimate of the Buyer's loss and not as a penalty in the nature of a continuing charge, a sum equal to 10% of the invoice value of the Equipment so delivered. This amount is payable once only in respect of the late delivery, and does not increase with the length of the delay. No such sum shall be payable where the delay does not exceed the first 2 days after the Delivery Deadline. The Buyer may deduct the amount payable under this clause from any sum due to the Vendor under the relevant Invoice.
